deficiencies.description: The rewrite uses 'since' to establish a causal link, asserting that the terminology is still heard because surgeons can tell whether a tumour is movable or immovable by holding or touching it. The source text does not state this causal relationship, instead using 'where' to describe the context or circumstances in which the terminology is used.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.
